name: ros2-benchmark-configs
description: A collection of ROS 2 benchmark configuration files and metadata intended to standardize and reproduce performance experiments for ROS 2 components and systems. The dataset provides machine-readable configs for benchmarking setups, allowing researchers to share, compare and reproduce robotics performance tests across different platforms and environments. It is primarily a utility dataset for robotics benchmarking rather than a predictive task dataset.
reputation: Niche utility dataset hosted on Hugging Face with modest community use among ROS/robotics practitioners for reproducible benchmarking setups.
